digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify corpus verification and Pandoc integration
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently performs complete live-Pandoc corpus work with 184+ seconds overhead per change and must migrate to committed deterministic artifacts for all corpus assertions while retaining one real product-path body per stratum.

A test-only static converter backed by committed artifacts must drive the production segmenting renderer through all corpus cardinality, scrubbing, protection, table, HTML-comment, settling, richness, alignment, byte-output, dispatch, fallback, and immutability assertions.

A dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay job in external-integration.yml with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix must run full replay on weekly schedule and workflow_dispatch, exercising every corpus unit and settling pass through installed real Pandoc.
Committed deterministic Pandoc outputs must preserve Pandoc 3.6.1 contract and Linux x86_64 and Darwin arm64 binary SHA-256 values across three files below 500 KiB repository file-size limits.
